remarks: Welcome to 1612 Amber Lane, a beautifully updated home offering luxury, functionality, and resort-style living. The desirable floor plan features a main-level bedroom and full bath, formal living and dining rooms, and a recently renovated chef's kitchen with a gas cooktop, electric range, quality finishes, stainless steel appliances, and abundant cabinetry that opens to the inviting family room with fireplace. Upstairs offers a versatile loft, three oversized secondary bedrooms, and a spacious primary suite with a large walk-in closet and spa-inspired bath featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub, and an oversized frameless shower. Two private offices with independent air conditioning provide exceptional work-from-home flexibility. Enjoy your own backyard retreat with a fully automated pool and spa built in 2021, complete with a lounging shelf. Additional highlights include a fully owned solar system, RV access, an expanded driveway, and an attached two-car garage with its own HVAC system, providing additional flexibility for a workshop, gym, or hobby space. Every detail has been thoughtfully designed for comfortable California living.
